req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that when a task is created via the POST /tasks/ endpoint without specifying the 'completed' field, it should default to false. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_default_completed_false
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid task payload omitting the 'completed' field.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "Test task description"}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_invalid_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an invalid task payload having an empty 'title'.
expected: The response contains validation error for 'title'.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "Test task description"}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task payload having a 'title' of maximum allowed length (100 characters).
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "Boundary test description"}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
